segments.mn85:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
segments.mn85:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena bodhissa rājakumārassa kokanado [kokanudo (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] nāma pāsādo acirakārito hoti anajjhāvuṭṭho samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
segments.mn85:3.1: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn85:3.2: “ehi tvaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vanda, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha –
segments.mn85:3.3: ‘bodhi, bhante, rājakumāro bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī’ti.
segments.mn85:3.5: ‘adhivāsetu kira, bhante, bhagavā bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’”ti.
segments.mn85:4.1: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho sañjikāputto māṇavo bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.mn85:4.2: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sañjikāputto māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:4.3: “bodhi kho [bodhi bho gotama (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] rājakumāro bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
segments.mn85:4.5: ‘adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ gotamo bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’”ti.
segments.mn85:4.7: Atha kho sañjikāputto māṇavo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bodhi rājakumāro tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:4.9: ‘bodhi kho rājakumāro bhoto gotamassa pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ pucchati.
segments.mn85:4.10: Evañca vadeti – adhivāsetu kira bhavaṃ gotamo bodhissa rājakumārassa svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā’ti.
segments.mn85:5.1: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā, kokanadañca pāsādaṃ odātehi dussehi santharāpetvā yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarā [kaḷebarā (sī.)], sañjikāputtaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantesi –
segments.mn85:5.2: “ehi tvaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkama; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocehi –
segments.mn85:5.4: “Evaṃ, bho”ti kho sañjikāputto māṇavo bodhissa rājakumārassa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocesi –
segments.mn85:6.1: Atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena bodhissa rājakumārassa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
segments.mn85:7.1: Tena kho pana samayena bodhi rājakumāro bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ āgamayamāno.
segments.mn85:7.2: Addasā kho bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.mn85:7.3: Disvāna paccuggantvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā purakkhatvā yena kokanado pāsādo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.mn85:7.4: Atha kho bhagavā pacchimaṃ sopānakaḷevaraṃ nissāya aṭṭhāsi.
segments.mn85:7.5: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:7.6: “abhiruhatu [abhirūhatu (syā. kaṃ. pī.) akkamatu (cūḷava.268)], bhante, bhagavā dussāni, abhiruhatu sugato dussāni;
segments.mn85:7.7: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
segments.mn85:7.9: Dutiyampi kho … pe … tatiyampi kho bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:7.11: “abhiruhatu, bhante, bhagavā. Dussāni, abhiruhatu sugato dussāni;
segments.mn85:7.12: yaṃ mama assa dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā”ti.
segments.mn85:7.13: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ apalokesi.
segments.mn85:7.14: Atha kho āyasmā ānando bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:8.1: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro dussāni saṃharāpetvā uparikokanadapāsāde [uparikokanade pāsāde (sī. pī. vinayeca), uparikokanade (syā. kaṃ.)] āsanāni paññapesi.
segments.mn85:8.2: Atha kho bhagavā kokanadaṃ pāsādaṃ abhiruhitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena.
segments.mn85:9.1: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
segments.mn85:9.2: Atha kho bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn85:9.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:9.5: ‘na kho sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabban’”ti.
segments.mn85:10.1: “Mayhampi kho, rājakumāra, pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi –
segments.mn85:10.2: ‘na kho sukhena sukhaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, dukkhena kho sukhaṃ adhigantabban’ti.
segments.mn85:11.1: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, aparena samayena daharova samāno susukāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā akāmakānaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
segments.mn85:11.2: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno kiṃkusalagavesī [kiṃkusalaṃgavesī (ka.)] anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:11.3: ‘icchāmahaṃ, āvuso kālāma, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun’ti.
segments.mn85:11.4: Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, āḷāro kālāmo maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:11.5: ‘viharatāyasmā, tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā’ti.
segments.mn85:11.7: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
segments.mn85:11.8: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi, theravādañca jānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañceva aññe ca.
segments.mn85:11.10: ‘na kho āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti;
segments.mn85:11.11: addhā āḷāro kālāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ viharatī’ti.
segments.mn85:12.1: “Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:12.2: ‘kittāvatā no, āvuso kālāma, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesī’ti [upasampajja pavedesīti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)]?
segments.mn85:12.3: Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, āḷāro kālāmo ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
segments.mn85:12.5: ‘na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi saddhā, mayhaṃpatthi saddhā;
segments.mn85:12.6: na kho āḷārasseva kālāmassa atthi vīriyaṃ … pe … sati … samādhi … paññā, mayhaṃpatthi paññā.
segments.mn85:12.10: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ āḷāro kālāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyan’ti.
segments.mn85:12.11: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:12.12: Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, yena āḷāro kālāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā āḷāraṃ kālāmaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:12.13: ‘ettāvatā no, āvuso kālāma, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī’ti?
segments.mn85:12.14: ‘Ettāvatā kho ahaṃ, āvuso, imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemī’ti.
segments.mn85:12.15: ‘Ahampi kho, āvuso, ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti.
segments.mn85:12.16: ‘Lābhā no, āvuso, suladdhaṃ no, āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.
segments.mn85:12.18: Iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi, taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
segments.mn85:12.19: Yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi, tamahaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedemi.
segments.mn85:12.20: Iti yāhaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi; yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi tamahaṃ dhammaṃ jānāmi.
segments.mn85:12.21: Iti yādiso ahaṃ, tādiso tuvaṃ; yādiso tuvaṃ tādiso ahaṃ.
segments.mn85:12.22: Ehi dāni, āvuso, ubhova santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā’ti.
segments.mn85:12.23: Iti kho, rājakumāra, āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno (attano)[() natthi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā [attano (sī. pī.)] samasamaṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
segments.mn85:12.25: ‘nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva ākiñcaññāyatanūpapattiyā’ti.
segments.mn85:12.26: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
segments.mn85:12.27: “So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno yena udako [uddako (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā udakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:12.28: ‘icchāmahaṃ, āvuso [āvuso rāma (sī. syā. kaṃ. ka.) passa ma. ni.1.278 pāsarāsisutte], imasmiṃ dhammavinaye brahmacariyaṃ caritun’ti.
segments.mn85:12.29: Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, udako rāmaputto maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:12.30: ‘viharatāyasmā, tādiso ayaṃ dhammo yattha viññū puriso nacirasseva sakaṃ ācariyakaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā’ti.
segments.mn85:12.32: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.
segments.mn85:12.33: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, tāvatakeneva oṭṭhapahatamattena lapitalāpanamattena ñāṇavādañca vadāmi, theravādañca jānāmi passāmīti ca paṭijānāmi, ahañceva aññe ca.
segments.mn85:12.35: ‘na kho rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ kevalaṃ saddhāmattakena sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesi;
segments.mn85:12.36: addhā rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ jānaṃ passaṃ vihāsī’ti.
segments.mn85:13.1: Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, yena udako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā udakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:13.2: ‘kittāvatā no, āvuso, rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedesī’ti?
segments.mn85:13.3: Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, udako rāmaputto nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ pavedesi.
segments.mn85:13.5: ‘na kho rāmasseva ahosi saddhā, mayhaṃpatthi saddhā;
segments.mn85:13.6: na kho rāmasseva ahosi vīriyaṃ … pe … sati … samādhi … paññā, mayhaṃpatthi paññā.
segments.mn85:13.10: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmīti pavedeti tassa dhammassa sacchikiriyāya padaheyyan’ti.
segments.mn85:13.11: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, nacirasseva khippameva taṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:13.12: “Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, yena udako rāmaputto tenupasaṅkamiṃ; upasaṅkamitvā udakaṃ rāmaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:13.13: ‘ettāvatā no, āvuso, rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī’ti?
segments.mn85:13.14: ‘Ettāvatā kho, āvuso, rāmo imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesī’ti.
segments.mn85:13.15: ‘Ahampi kho, āvuso, ettāvatā imaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’ti.
segments.mn85:13.16: ‘Lābhā no, āvuso, suladdhaṃ no, āvuso, ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ sabrahmacāriṃ passāma.
segments.mn85:13.18: Iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi.
segments.mn85:13.19: Yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharasi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja pavedesi.
segments.mn85:13.20: Iti yaṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi taṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi; yaṃ tvaṃ dhammaṃ jānāsi taṃ dhammaṃ rāmo abhiññāsi.
segments.mn85:13.21: Iti yādiso rāmo ahosi tādiso tuvaṃ, yādiso tuvaṃ tādiso rāmo ahosi.
segments.mn85:13.22: Ehi dāni, āvuso, tuvaṃ imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharā’ti.
segments.mn85:13.23: Iti kho, rājakumāra, udako rāmaputto sabrahmacārī me samāno ācariyaṭṭhāne maṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
segments.mn85:13.25: ‘nāyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvadeva nevasaññānāsaññāyatanūpapattiyā’ti.
segments.mn85:13.26: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, taṃ dhammaṃ analaṅkaritvā tasmā dhammā nibbijja apakkamiṃ.
segments.mn85:14.1: “So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, kiṃkusalagavesī anuttaraṃ santivarapadaṃ pariyesamāno, magadhesu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno, yena uruvelā senānigamo tadavasariṃ.
segments.mn85:14.2: Tatthaddasaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ bhūmibhāgaṃ, pāsādikañca vanasaṇḍaṃ, nadīñca sandantiṃ setakaṃ supatitthaṃ, ramaṇīyaṃ samantā ca gocaragāmaṃ. Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, etadahosi – ‘ramaṇīyo vata, bho, bhūmibhāgo, pāsādiko ca vanasaṇḍo, nadiñca sandantiṃ setakā supatitthā, ramaṇīyā samantā [sāmantā (?) purimapiṭṭhepi] ca gocaragāmo.
segments.mn85:14.6: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, tattheva nisīdiṃ –
segments.mn85:15.1: Apissu maṃ, rājakumāra, tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:16.1: “Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ.
segments.mn85:16.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento [abhimatthanto (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:16.8: Aduñhi, bhante, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ tañca pana udake nikkhittaṃ, yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā”ti.
segments.mn85:17.1: “Evameva kho, rājakumāra, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva cittena ca kāmehi avūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho.
segments.mn85:17.2: Opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:17.3: No cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:17.4: Ayaṃ kho maṃ, rājakumāra, paṭhamā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:18.1: “Aparāpi kho maṃ, rājakumāra, dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:18.2: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
segments.mn85:18.5: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso amuṃ allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:18.9: Aduñhi, bhante, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ kiñcāpi ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ, yāvadeva ca pana so puriso kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assā”ti.
segments.mn85:18.11: “Evameva kho, rājakumāra, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva cittena ca kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ na suppahīno hoti, na suppaṭippassaddho.
segments.mn85:18.12: Opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:18.13: No cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, abhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:18.14: Ayaṃ kho maṃ, rājakumāra, dutiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:19.1: “Aparāpi kho maṃ, rājakumāra, tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:19.2: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ.
segments.mn85:19.5: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso amuṃ sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ ārakā udakā thale nikkhittaṃ uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya abhimanthento aggiṃ abhinibbatteyya, tejo pātukareyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:19.9: Aduñhi, bhante, sukkhaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ koḷāpaṃ, tañca pana ārakā udakā thale nikkhittan”ti.
segments.mn85:19.10: “Evameva kho, rājakumāra, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā kāyena ceva cittena ca kāmehi vūpakaṭṭhā viharanti, yo ca nesaṃ kāmesu kāmacchando kāmasneho kāmamucchā kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho so ca ajjhattaṃ suppahīno hoti suppaṭippassaddho.
segments.mn85:19.11: Opakkamikā cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, bhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:19.12: No cepi te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, bhabbāva te ñāṇāya dassanāya anuttarāya sambodhāya.
segments.mn85:19.13: Ayaṃ kho maṃ, rājakumāra, tatiyā upamā paṭibhāsi anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:19.14: Imā kho maṃ, rājakumāra, tisso upamā paṭibhaṃsu anacchariyā pubbe assutapubbā.
segments.mn85:20.2: ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ dantebhidantamādhāya [passa ma. ni.1.220 vitakkasaṇṭhānasutte], jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇheyyaṃ abhinippīḷeyyaṃ abhisantāpeyyan’ti.
segments.mn85:20.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, dantebhidantamādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhāmi abhinippīḷemi abhisantāpemi.
segments.mn85:20.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, dantebhidantamādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
segments.mn85:20.5: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, balavā puriso dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ sīse vā gahetvā khandhe vā gahetvā abhiniggaṇheyya abhinippīḷeyya abhisantāpeyya;
segments.mn85:20.6: evameva kho me, rājakumāra, dantebhidantamādhāya, jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca, cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhato abhinippīḷayato abhisantāpayato kacchehi sedā muccanti.
segments.mn85:20.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:21.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
segments.mn85:21.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
segments.mn85:21.5: Seyyathāpi nāma kammāragaggariyā dhamamānāya adhimatto saddo hoti, evameva kho me, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu kaṇṇasotehi vātānaṃ nikkhamantānaṃ adhimatto saddo hoti.
segments.mn85:21.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:22.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
segments.mn85:22.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti [ūhanti (sī.), ohananti (syā. kaṃ.), uhananti (ka.)].
segments.mn85:22.5: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhani abhimattheyya [muddhānaṃ abhimantheyya (sī. pī.), muddhānaṃ abhimattheyya (syā. kaṃ.)], evameva kho me, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā muddhani ūhananti.
segments.mn85:22.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:23.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
segments.mn85:23.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.
segments.mn85:23.5: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhaṇḍena [varattakabandhanena (sī.)] sīse sīsaveṭhaṃ dadeyya;
segments.mn85:23.6: evameva kho me, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā honti.
segments.mn85:23.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:24.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
segments.mn85:24.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
segments.mn85:24.5: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evameva kho me, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimattā, vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti.
segments.mn85:24.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:25.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāse uparundhiṃ.
segments.mn85:25.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho hoti.
segments.mn85:25.5: Seyyathāpi, rājakumāra, dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ samparitāpeyyuṃ, evameva kho me, rājakumāra, mukhato ca nāsato ca kaṇṇato ca assāsapassāsesu uparuddhesu adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho hoti.
segments.mn85:25.7: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me, rājakumāra, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho, teneva dukkhappadhānena padhānābhitunnassa sato.
segments.mn85:26.4: ‘na kālaṅkato samaṇo gotamo, api ca kālaṅkarotī’ti.
segments.mn85:26.6: ‘na kālaṅkato samaṇo gotamo, nāpi kālaṅkaroti. Arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo. Vihārotveva so [vihārotveveso (sī.)] arahato evarūpo hotī’ti [vihārotveveso arahato”ti (?)].
segments.mn85:27.3: Atha kho maṃ, rājakumāra, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn85:27.4: ‘mā kho tvaṃ, mārisa, sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajji.
segments.mn85:27.5: Sace kho tvaṃ, mārisa, sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajjissasi, tassa te mayaṃ dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāressāma [ajjhoharissāma (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], tāya tvaṃ yāpessasī’ti.
segments.mn85:27.7: ‘ahañceva kho pana sabbaso ajajjitaṃ [ajaddhukaṃ (sī. pī.), jaddhukaṃ (syā. kaṃ.)] paṭijāneyyaṃ. Imā ca me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohāreyyuṃ [ajjhohareyyuṃ (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], tāya cāhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ, taṃ mamassa musā’ti.
segments.mn85:27.8: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, tā devatā paccācikkhāmi. ‘Halan’ti vadāmi.
segments.mn85:28.2: ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsan’ti.
segments.mn85:28.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
segments.mn85:28.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato pasataṃ pasataṃ, yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ, adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
segments.mn85:28.5: Seyyathāpi nāma āsītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā, evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.6: Seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ, evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.7: Seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī, evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako uṇṇatāvanato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.8: Seyyathāpi nāma jarasālāya gopānasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.9: Seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre udapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti, evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.10: Seyyathāpi nāma tittakālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena saṃphuṭito [samphusito (syā. kaṃ.), saṃpuṭīto (ka.) saṃphuṭitoti ettha saṅkucitoti attho] hoti sammilāto, evamevassu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.11: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra,‘udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmī’ti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi,‘piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmī’ti udaracchaviṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi. Yāvassu me, rājakumāra, udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.12: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra,‘vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmī’ti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:28.13: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, imameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi. Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:29.1: Apissu maṃ, rājakumāra, manussā disvā evamāhaṃsu – ‘kāḷo samaṇo gotamo’ti, ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu –
segments.mn85:29.2: ‘na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, sāmo samaṇo gotamo’ti.
segments.mn85:29.3: Ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu – ‘na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, napi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo’ti.
segments.mn85:29.4: Yāvassu me, rājakumāra, tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
segments.mn85:30.2: ‘ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā [tippā (sī. pī.)] kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayiṃsu, etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
segments.mn85:30.3: Yepi hi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayissanti, etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
segments.mn85:30.4: Yepi hi keci etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedayanti, etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
segments.mn85:30.5: Na kho panāhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ;
segments.mn85:30.6: siyā nu kho añño maggo bodhāyā’ti.
segments.mn85:31.2: ‘abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ pitu sakkassa kammante sītāya jambucchāyāya nisinno vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā;
segments.mn85:31.3: siyā nu kho eso maggo bodhāyā’ti.
segments.mn85:31.4: Tassa mayhaṃ, rājakumāra, satānusāri viññāṇaṃ ahosi –
segments.mn85:32.2: ‘kiṃ nu kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehī’ti?
segments.mn85:32.4: ‘na kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yaṃ taṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehī’ti.
segments.mn85:33.2: ‘na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena. Yaṃnūnāhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāreyyaṃ odanakummāsan’ti.
segments.mn85:33.3: So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ.
segments.mn85:33.4: Tena kho pana maṃ, rājakumāra, samayena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti –
segments.mn85:33.5: ‘yaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati taṃ no ārocessatī’ti.
segments.mn85:33.6: Yato kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanakummāsaṃ, atha me te pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu –
segments.mn85:33.7: ‘bāhulliko [bāhuliko (sī. pī.) sāratthaṭīkāya saṃghabhedasikkhāpadavaṇṇanāya sameti] samaṇo gotamo padhānavibbhanto, āvatto bāhullāyā’ti.
segments.mn85:34-37.1: “So kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāretvā balaṃ gahetvā vivicceva kāmehi … pe … paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:34-37.2: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā … dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ … tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ … catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:34-37.5: So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
segments.mn85:34-37.6: So anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi, seyyathidaṃ – ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo … pe … iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
segments.mn85:34-37.7: Ayaṃ kho me, rājakumāra, rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā, avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā;
segments.mn85:34-37.8: tamo vihato, āloko uppanno – yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
segments.mn85:38.1: “So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
segments.mn85:38.2: So dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi … pe … ayaṃ kho me, rājakumāra, rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā vijjā adhigatā, avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā;
segments.mn85:39.1: tamo vihato, āloko uppanno – yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
segments.mn85:40.1: “So evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
segments.mn85:40.2: So ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ;
segments.mn85:40.3: ‘ime āsavā’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ … pe …‘ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:41.1: Tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha.
segments.mn85:41.3: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsiṃ.
segments.mn85:42.1: Ayaṃ kho me, rājakumāra, rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā vijjā adhigatā, avijjā vihatā, vijjā uppannā;
segments.mn85:42.2: tamo vihato, āloko uppanno – yathā taṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
segments.mn85:43.2: ‘adhigato kho myāyaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo.
segments.mn85:43.3: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālayasammuditā.
segments.mn85:43.4: Ālayarāmāya kho pana pajāya ālayaratāya ālayasammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ – idappaccayatāpaṭiccasamuppādo.
segments.mn85:43.5: Idampi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ – yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
segments.mn85:43.6: Ahañceva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mamassa kilamatho, sā mamassa vihesā’ti.
segments.mn85:43.7: Apissu maṃ, rājakumāra, imā anacchariyā gāthāyo paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā –
segments.mn85:43.14: Rāgarattā na dakkhanti, tamokhandhena āvuṭā’[āvaṭā (sī.), āvutā (syā. kaṃ.)] ti.
segments.mn85:43.16: “Itiha me, rājakumāra, paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati no dhammadesanāya.
segments.mn85:44.1: “Atha kho, rājakumāra, brahmuno sahampatissa mama cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya etadahosi –
segments.mn85:44.2: ‘nassati vata, bho, loko; vinassati vata, bho, loko. Yatra hi nāma tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati [namissati (?)] no dhammadesanāyā’ti.
segments.mn85:44.3: Atha kho, rājakumāra, brahmā sahampati – seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evameva – brahmaloke antarahito mama purato pāturahosi.
segments.mn85:44.4: Atha kho, rājakumāra, brahmā sahampati ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yenāhaṃ tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:44.5: ‘desetu, bhante, bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ.
segments.mn85:44.6: Santi sattā apparajakkhajātikā assavanatāya dhammassa parihāyanti;
segments.mn85:44.21: Satthavāha aṇaṇa [anaṇa (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)], vicara loke;
segments.mn85:45.1: “Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññataṃ paṭicca buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokesiṃ.
segments.mn85:45.2: Addasaṃ kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine [dassāvino (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
segments.mn85:45.3: Seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakā accuggamma ṭhitāni [tiṭṭhanti (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] anupalittāni udakena, evameva kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasaṃ satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye, appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvine viharante.
segments.mn85:45.5: Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, brahmānaṃ sahampatiṃ gāthāya paccabhāsiṃ –
segments.mn85:45.10: “Atha kho, rājakumāra, brahmā sahampati ‘katāvakāso khomhi bhagavatā dhammadesanāyā’ti maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
segments.mn85:46.2: ‘kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
segments.mn85:46.5: ‘ayaṃ kho āḷāro kālāmo paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
segments.mn85:46.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ āḷārassa kālāmassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ;
segments.mn85:46.8: Atha kho maṃ, rājakumāra, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca –
segments.mn85:46.14: Sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippameva ājāneyyā’ti.
segments.mn85:47.2: ‘kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
segments.mn85:47.5: ‘ayaṃ kho udako rāmaputto paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī dīgharattaṃ apparajakkhajātiko.
segments.mn85:47.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ udakassa rāmaputtassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ;
segments.mn85:47.8: Atha kho maṃ, rājakumāra, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca –
segments.mn85:47.14: Sace hi so imaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, khippameva ājāneyyā’ti.
segments.mn85:48.2: ‘kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ?
segments.mn85:48.5: ‘bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū ye maṃ padhānapahitattaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu.
segments.mn85:48.6: Yaṃnūnāhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan’ti.
segments.mn85:48.8: ‘kahaṃ nu kho etarahi pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū viharantī’ti.
segments.mn85:48.9: Addasaṃ khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena pañcavaggiye bhikkhū bārāṇasiyaṃ viharante isipatane migadāye.
segments.mn85:49.1: Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, uruvelāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena bārāṇasī tena cārikaṃ pakkamiṃ.
segments.mn85:49.2: “Addasā kho maṃ, rājakumāra, upako ājīvako antarā ca gayaṃ antarā ca bodhiṃ addhānamaggappaṭipannaṃ.
segments.mn85:49.4: ‘vippasannāni kho te, āvuso, indriyāni, parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto.
segments.mn85:49.5: Kaṃsi tvaṃ, āvuso, uddissa pabbajito? Ko vā te satthā? Kassa vā tvaṃ dhammaṃ rocesī’ti?
segments.mn85:49.6: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, rājakumāra, upakaṃ ājīvakaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsiṃ –
segments.mn85:49.11: ‘Na me ācariyo atthi, sadiso me na vijjati;
segments.mn85:49.21: Andhībhūtasmiṃ [andhabhūtasmiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] lokasmiṃ, āhañchaṃ [āhaññiṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] amatadundubhin’ti.
segments.mn85:49.23: ‘Yathā kho tvaṃ, āvuso, paṭijānāsi arahasi anantajino’ti.
segments.mn85:49.24: ‘Mādisā ve jinā honti, ye pattā āsavakkhayaṃ;
segments.mn85:49.26: Jitā me pāpakā dhammā, tasmāhamupaka [tasmāhaṃ upakā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] jino’ti.
segments.mn85:49.28: “Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, upako ājīvako ‘hupeyyapāvuso’ti [huveyyapāvuso (sī. pī.), huveyyāvuso (syā. kaṃ.)] vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.
segments.mn85:50.1: “Atha khvāhaṃ, rājakumāra, anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena bārāṇasī isipatanaṃ migadāyo yena pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
segments.mn85:50.2: Addasaṃsu kho maṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.mn85:50.4: ‘ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya.
segments.mn85:50.5: So neva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, nāssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ;
segments.mn85:50.6: api ca kho āsanaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ – sace so ākaṅkhissati nisīdissatī’ti.
segments.mn85:50.7: Yathā yathā kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū upasaṅkamiṃ [upasaṅkamāmi (sī. pī.)], tathā tathā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū nāsakkhiṃsu sakāya katikāya saṇṭhātuṃ.
segments.mn85:50.8: Appekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ. Appekacce āsanaṃ paññapesuṃ. Appekacce pādodakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ.
segments.mn85:50.9: Api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.
segments.mn85:51.1: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:51.2: ‘mā, bhikkhave, tathāgataṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaratha [samudācarittha (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)];
segments.mn85:51.4: Odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ. Amatamadhigataṃ. Ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.mn85:51.5: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā’ti.
segments.mn85:51.6: Evaṃ vutte, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn85:51.7: ‘tāyapi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya [cariyāya (syā. kaṃ.)] tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ; kiṃ pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan’ti?
segments.mn85:51.8: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:51.9: ‘na, bhikkhave, tathāgato bāhulliko na padhānavibbhanto na āvatto bāhullāya.
segments.mn85:51.11: Odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ. Amatamadhigataṃ. Ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.mn85:51.12: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā’ti.
segments.mn85:51.13: Dutiyampi kho, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn85:51.14: ‘tāyapi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ; kiṃ pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan’ti?
segments.mn85:51.15: Dutiyampi kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:51.16: ‘na, bhikkhave, tathāgato bāhulliko na padhānavibbhanto na āvatto bāhullāya.
segments.mn85:51.18: Odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ. Amatamadhigataṃ. Ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.mn85:51.19: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā’ti.
segments.mn85:51.20: Tatiyampi kho, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū maṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.mn85:51.21: ‘tāyapi kho tvaṃ, āvuso gotama, iriyāya tāya paṭipadāya tāya dukkarakārikāya nājjhagamā uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ; kiṃ pana tvaṃ etarahi bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya adhigamissasi uttarimanussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesan’ti?
segments.mn85:52.1: Evaṃ vutte, ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn85:52.2: ‘abhijānātha me no tumhe, bhikkhave, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ pabhāvitametan’ti [bhāsitametanti (sī. syā. vinayepi)]?
segments.mn85:52.5: Odahatha, bhikkhave, sotaṃ. Amatamadhigataṃ. Ahamanusāsāmi, ahaṃ dhammaṃ desemi.
segments.mn85:52.6: Yathānusiṭṭhaṃ tathā paṭipajjamānā nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissathā’ti.
segments.mn85:53.1: “Asakkhiṃ kho ahaṃ, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiye bhikkhū saññāpetuṃ.
segments.mn85:53.2: Dvepi sudaṃ, rājakumāra, bhikkhū ovadāmi. Tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caranti.
segments.mn85:53.3: Yaṃ tayo bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharanti, tena chabbaggiyā [chabbaggā (sī. syā. kaṃ.), chabbaggo (pī.)] yāpema.
segments.mn85:53.4: Tayopi sudaṃ, rājakumāra, bhikkhū ovadāmi, dve bhikkhū piṇḍāya caranti.
segments.mn85:53.5: Yaṃ dve bhikkhū piṇḍāya caritvā āharanti tena chabbaggiyā yāpema.
segments.mn85:54.1: “Atha kho, rājakumāra, pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihariṃsū”ti.
segments.mn85:55.1: Evaṃ vutte, bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:55.2: “kīva cirena nu kho, bhante, bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ [nāyakaṃ (?)] labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:55.3: “Tena hi, rājakumāra, taṃyevettha paṭipucchissāmi. Yathā te khameyya, tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi.
segments.mn85:55.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, kusalo tvaṃ hatthārūḷhe [hatthārūyhe (sī. pī.)] aṅkusagayhe [aṅkusagaṇhe (syā. kaṃ.)] sippe”ti?
segments.mn85:55.6: “Evaṃ, bhante, kusalo ahaṃ hatthārūḷhe aṅkusagayhe sippe”ti.
segments.mn85:56.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, idha puriso āgaccheyya –
segments.mn85:56.4: tassāhaṃ santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkhissāmī’ti.
segments.mn85:56.6: yāvatakaṃ saddhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:56.8: yāvatakaṃ appābādhena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:56.10: yāvatakaṃ asaṭhena amāyāvinā pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:56.12: yāvatakaṃ āraddhavīriyena pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:56.14: yāvatakaṃ paññavatā pattabbaṃ taṃ na sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:56.15: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso tava santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:56.17: “Ekamekenāpi, bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso na mama santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya, ko pana vādo pañcahaṅgehī”ti!
segments.mn85:57.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, idha puriso āgaccheyya –
segments.mn85:57.4: tassāhaṃ santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkhissāmī’ti.
segments.mn85:57.10: yāvatakaṃ asaṭhena amāyāvinā pattabbaṃ taṃ sampāpuṇeyya.
segments.mn85:57.15: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, rājakumāra, api nu so puriso tava santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyyā”ti?
segments.mn85:57.17: “Ekamekenāpi, bhante, aṅgena samannāgato so puriso mama santike hatthārūḷhaṃ aṅkusagayhaṃ sippaṃ sikkheyya, ko pana vādo pañcahaṅgehī”ti!
segments.mn85:58.3: Idha, rājakumāra, bhikkhu saddho hoti; saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ –
segments.mn85:58.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti;
segments.mn85:58.5: appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya;
segments.mn85:58.6: asaṭho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu;
segments.mn85:58.7: āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu;
segments.mn85:58.8: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
segments.mn85:59.1: “Imehi, rājakumāra, pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya satta vassāni.
segments.mn85:59.4: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya chabbassāni … pañca vassāni … cattāri vassāni … tīṇi vassāni … dve vassāni … ekaṃ vassaṃ.
segments.mn85:59.12: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya satta māsāni.
segments.mn85:59.15: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya cha māsāni … pañca māsāni … cattāri māsāni … tīṇi māsāni … dve māsāni … ekaṃ māsaṃ … aḍḍhamāsaṃ.
segments.mn85:59.25: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya satta rattindivāni.
segments.mn85:59.29: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya cha rattindivāni … pañca rattindivāni … cattāri rattindivāni … tīṇi rattindivāni … dve rattindivāni … ekaṃ rattindivaṃ.
segments.mn85:59.38: Imehi pañcahi padhāniyaṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu tathāgataṃ vināyakaṃ labhamāno sāyamanusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissati, pātamanusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatī”ti.
segments.mn85:60.1: Evaṃ vutte, bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:60.2: “aho buddho, aho dhammo, aho dhammassa svākkhātatā!
segments.mn85:60.3: Yatra hi nāma sāyamanusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissati, pātamanusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatī”ti!
segments.mn85:61.1: Evaṃ vutte, sañjikāputto māṇavo bodhiṃ rājakumāraṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:61.3: ‘aho buddho, aho dhammo, aho dhammassa svākkhātatā’ti ca vadeti [vadesi (sī.), pavedeti (syā. kaṃ.)];
segments.mn85:61.4: atha ca pana na taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañcā”ti.
segments.mn85:61.5: “Mā hevaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, avaca; mā hevaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, avaca.
segments.mn85:61.6: Sammukhā metaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, ayyāya sutaṃ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ”.
segments.mn85:61.7: “Ekamidaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
segments.mn85:61.8: Atha kho me ayyā kucchimatī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho me ayyā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:61.9: ‘yo me ayaṃ, bhante, kucchigato kumārako vā kumārikā vā so bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.mn85:61.10: Upāsakaṃ taṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan’ti.
segments.mn85:61.11: Ekamidaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, samayaṃ bhagavā idheva bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
segments.mn85:61.12: Atha kho maṃ dhāti aṅkena haritvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho maṃ dhāti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn85:61.13: ‘ayaṃ, bhante, bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchati dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.mn85:61.14: Upāsakaṃ taṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan’ti.
segments.mn85:61.15: Esāhaṃ, samma sañjikāputta, tatiyakampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.mn85:61.16: Upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: Evaṃ me sutanti bodhirājakumārasuttaṃ.
Tattha kokanadoti kokanadaṃ vuccati padumaṃ.
So ca maṅgalapāsādo olokanakapadumaṃ dassetvā kato, tasmā kokanadoti saṅkhaṃ labhi.
Yāva pacchimasopānakaḷevarāti ettha pacchimasopānakaḷevaranti paṭhamaṃ sopānaphalakaṃ vuttaṃ.
Addasā khoti olokanatthaṃyeva dvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito addasa.
Bhagavā tuṇhī ahosīti “kissa nu kho atthāya rājakumārena ayaṃ mahāsakkāro kato”ti āvajjanto puttapatthanāya katabhāvaṃ aññāsi.
So hi rājakumāro aputtako, sutañcānena ahosi –
“buddhānaṃ kira adhikāraṃ katvā manasā icchitaṃ labhantī”ti.
So –
“sacāhaṃ puttaṃ labhissāmi, sammāsambuddho mama celappaṭikaṃ akkamissati.
No ce labhissāmi, na akkamissatī”ti patthanaṃ katvā santharāpesi.
Atha bhagavā “nibbattissati nu kho etassa putto”ti āvajjetvā “na nibbattissatī”ti addasa.
Pubbe kira so ekasmiṃ dīpe vasamāno samacchandena sakuṇapotake khādi.
Sacassa mātugāmo aññova bhaveyya, puttaṃ labheyya.
Ubhohi pana samānacchandehi hutvā pāpakammaṃ kataṃ, tenassa putto na nibbattissatīti aññāsi.
Dusse pana akkante –
“buddhānaṃ adhikāraṃ katvā patthitapatthitaṃ labhantīti loke anussavo, mayā ca mahāabhinīhāro kato, na ca puttaṃ labhāmi, tucchaṃ idaṃ vacanan”ti micchāgahaṇaṃ gaṇheyya.
Titthiyāpi –
“natthi samaṇānaṃ akattabbaṃ nāma, celappaṭikaṃ maddantā āhiṇḍantī”ti ujjhāyeyyuṃ.
Etarahi ca akkamantesu bahū bhikkhū paracittaviduno, te bhabbaṃ jānitvā akkamissanti, abhabbaṃ jānitvā na akkamissanti.
Anāgate pana upanissayo mando bhavissati, anāgataṃ na jānissanti.
Tesu akkamantesu sace patthitaṃ ijjhissati, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
No ce ijjhissati,–
“pubbe bhikkhusaṅghassa abhinīhāraṃ katvā icchiticchitaṃ labhanti, taṃ idāni na labhanti.
Teyeva maññe bhikkhū paṭipattipūrakā ahesuṃ, ime paṭipattiṃ pūretuṃ na sakkontī”ti manussā vippaṭisārino bhavissantīti imehi kāraṇehi bhagavā akkamituṃ anicchanto tuṇhī ahosi.
Sikkhāpadaṃ paññapesi “na, bhikkhave, celappaṭikā akkamitabbā”ti (cūḷava.268).
Maṅgalatthāya paññattaṃ anakkamantesu pana akkamanatthāya anupaññattiṃ ṭhapesi –
“gihī, bhikkhave, maṅgalikā, anujānāmi, bhikkhave, gihīnaṃ maṅgalatthāyā”ti (cūḷava.268).
Pacchimaṃ janataṃ tathāgato anukampatīti idaṃ thero vuttesu kāraṇesu tatiyaṃ kāraṇaṃ sandhāyāha.
Na kho sukhena sukhanti kasmā āha?
Kāmasukhallikānuyogasaññī hutvā sammāsambuddho na akkami, tasmā ahampi satthārā samānacchando bhavissāmīti maññamāno evamāha.
So kho ahantiādi “yāva rattiyā pacchime yāme”ti tāva mahāsaccake (ma. ni.1.364 ādayo) vuttanayena veditabbaṃ.
Tato paraṃ yāva pañcavaggiyānaṃ āsavakkhayā pāsarāsisutte (ma. ni.1.272 ādayo) vuttanayena veditabbaṃ.
Aṅkusagayhe sippeti aṅkusagahaṇasippe.
Kusalo ahanti cheko ahaṃ.
Kassa panāyaṃ santike sippaṃ uggaṇhīti?
Pitu santike, pitāpissa pitu santikeva uggaṇhi.
Kosambiyaṃ kira parantaparājā nāma rajjaṃ kāresi.
Rājamahesī garubhārā ākāsatale raññā saddhiṃ bālātapaṃ tappamānā rattakambalaṃ pārupitvā nisinnā hoti, eko hatthiliṅgasakuṇo “maṃsapesī”ti maññamāno gahetvā ākāsaṃ pakkhandi.
Sā “chaḍḍeyya man”ti bhayena nissaddā ahosi, so taṃ pabbatapāde rukkhaviṭape ṭhapesi.
Sā pāṇissaraṃ karontī mahāsaddamakāsi.
Sakuṇo palāyi, tassā tattheva gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ ahosi.
Tiyāmarattiṃ deve vassante kambalaṃ pārupitvā nisīdi.
Tato ca avidūre tāpaso vasati.
So tassā saddena aruṇe uggate rukkhamūlaṃ āgato jātiṃ pucchitvā nisseṇiṃ bandhitvā otāretvā attano vasanaṭṭhānaṃ netvā yāguṃ pāyesi.
Dārakassa meghautuñca pabbatautuñca gahetvā jātattā udenoti nāmaṃ akāsi.
Tāpaso phalāphalāni āharitvā dvepi jane posesi.
Sā ekadivasaṃ tāpasassa āgamanavelāya paccuggamanaṃ katvā itthikuttaṃ dassetvā tāpasaṃ sīlabhedaṃ āpādesi.
Tesaṃ ekato vasantānaṃ kāle gacchante parantaparājā kālaṃ akāsi.
Tāpaso rattibhāge nakkhattaṃ oloketvā rañño matabhāvaṃ ñatvā –
“tuyhaṃ rājā mato, putto te kiṃ idha vasituṃ icchati, udāhu pettike rajje chattaṃ ussāpetun”ti pucchi.
Sā puttassa ādito paṭṭhāya sabbaṃ pavattiṃ ācikkhitvā chattaṃ ussāpetukāmatañcassa ñatvā tāpasassa ārocesi.
Tāpaso ca hatthiganthasippaṃ jānāti, kutonena laddhaṃ?
Sakkassa santikā.
Pubbe kirassa sakko upaṭṭhānaṃ āgantvā “kena kilamathā”ti pucchi.
So “hatthiparissayo atthī”ti ārocesi.
Tassa sakko hatthiganthañceva vīṇakañca datvā “palāpetukāmatāya sati imaṃ tantiṃ vādetvā imaṃ silokaṃ vadeyyātha, pakkositukāmatāya sati imaṃ silokaṃ vadeyyāthā”ti āha.
Tāpaso taṃ sippaṃ kumārassa adāsi.
So ekaṃ vaṭarukkhaṃ abhiruhitvā hatthīsu āgatesu tantiṃ vādetvā silokaṃ vadati, hatthī bhītā palāyiṃsu.
So sippassa ānubhāvaṃ ñatvā punadivase pakkosanasippaṃ payojesi.
Jeṭṭhakahatthī āgantvā khandhaṃ upanāmesi.
So tassa khandhagato yuddhasamatthe taruṇahatthī uccinitvā kambalañca muddikañca gahetvā mātāpitaro vanditvā nikkhanto anupubbena taṃ taṃ gāmaṃ pavisitvā –
“ahaṃ rañño putto, sampattiṃ atthikā āgacchantū”ti janasaṅgahaṃ katvā nagaraṃ parivāretvā –
“ahaṃ rañño putto, mayhaṃ chattaṃ dethā”ti asaddahantānaṃ kambalañca muddikañca dassetvā chattaṃ ussāpesi.
So hatthivittako hutvā “asukaṭṭhāne sundaro hatthī atthī”ti vutte gantvā gaṇhāti.
Caṇḍapajjoto “tassa santike sippaṃ gaṇhissāmī”ti kaṭṭhahatthiṃ payojetvā tassa anto yodhe nisīdāpetvā taṃ hatthiṃ gahaṇatthāya āgataṃ gaṇhitvā tassa santike sippaṃ gahaṇatthāya dhītaraṃ uyyojesi.
So tāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappetvā taṃ gahetvā attano nagaraṃyeva agamāsi.
Tassā kucchiyaṃ uppanno ayaṃ bodhirājakumāro attano pitu santike sippaṃ uggaṇhi.
Padhāniyaṅgānīti padhānaṃ vuccati padahanabhāvo, padhānamassa atthīti padhāniyo.
Padhāniyassa bhikkhuno aṅgānīti padhāniyaṅgāni.
Saddhoti saddhāya samannāgato.
Sā panesā āgamanasaddhā adhigamasaddhā okappanasaddhā pasādasaddhāti catubbidhā.
Tattha sabbaññubodhisattānaṃ saddhā abhinīhārato paṭṭhāya āgatattā āgamanasaddhā nāma.
Ariyasāvakānaṃ paṭivedhena adhigatattā adhigamasaddhā nāma.
Buddho dhammo saṅghoti vutte acalabhāvena okappanaṃ okappanasaddhā nāma.
Pasāduppatti pasādasaddhā nāma, idha pana okappanasaddhā adhippetā.
Bodhinti catumaggañāṇaṃ.
Taṃ suppaṭividdhaṃ tathāgatenāti saddahati, desanāsīsameva cetaṃ, iminā pana aṅgena tīsupi ratanesu saddhā adhippetā.
Yassa hi buddhādīsu pasādo balavā, tassa padhānaṃ vīriyaṃ ijjhati.
Appābādhoti arogo.
Appātaṅkoti niddukkho.
Samavepākiniyāti samavipācaniyā.
Gahaṇiyāti kammajatejodhātuyā.
Nātisītāya nāccuṇhāyāti atisītagahaṇiko hi sītabhīrū hoti, accuṇhagahaṇiko uṇhabhīrū, tesaṃ padhānaṃ na ijjhati.
Majjhimagahaṇikassa ijjhati.
Tenāha “majjhimāya padhānakkhamāyā”ti.
Yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattāti yathābhūtaṃ attano aguṇaṃ pakāsetā.
Udayatthagāminiyāti udayañca atthañca gantuṃ paricchindituṃ samatthāya, etena paññāsalakkhaṇapariggāhikaṃ udayabbayañāṇaṃ vuttaṃ.
Ariyāyāti parisuddhāya.
Nibbedhikāyāti anibbiddhapubbe lobhakkhandhādayo nibbijjhituṃ samatthāya.
Sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyāti tadaṅgavasena kilesānaṃ pahīnattā yaṃ dukkhaṃ khīyati, tassa dukkhassa khayagāminiyā.
Iti sabbehipi imehi padehi vipassanāpaññāva kathitā.
Duppaññassa hi padhānaṃ na ijjhati.
Imāni ca pañca padhāniyaṅgāni lokiyāneva veditabbāni.

words: aho buddho aho dhammo aho dhammassa svākkhātatā
lines: Sāyamanusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissatīti atthaṅgate sūriye anusiṭṭho aruṇuggamane visesaṃ adhigamissati.
Pātamanusiṭṭho sāyanti aruṇuggamane anusiṭṭho sūriyatthaṅgamanavelāyaṃ.
Ayañca pana desanā neyyapuggalavasena vuttā.
Dandhapañño hi neyyapuggalo sattahi divasehi arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, tikkhapañño ekadivasena, sesadivase majjhimapaññāvasena veditabbaṃ.
Aho buddho aho dhammo aho dhammassa svākkhātatāti yasmā buddhadhammānaṃ uḷāratāya dhammassa ca svākkhātatāya pāto kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathāpetvā sāyaṃ arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, tasmā pasaṃsanto evamāha.
Yatra hi nāmāti vimhayatthe nipāto.
Kucchimatīti āpannasattā.
Yo me ayaṃ, bhante, kucchigatoti kiṃ panevaṃ saraṇaṃ gahitaṃ hotīti.
Na hoti.
Acittakasaraṇagamanaṃ nāma natthi, ārakkho panassa paccupaṭṭhitova hoti.
Atha naṃ yadā mahallakakāle mātāpitaro,–
“tāta, kucchigatameva taṃ saraṇaṃ gaṇhāpayimhā”ti sārenti, so ca sallakkhetvā “ahaṃ saraṇaṃ gato upāsako”ti satiṃ uppādeti, tadā saraṇaṃ gahitaṃ nāma hoti.
Sesaṃ sabbattha uttānamevāti.
Atha naṃ bhagavā tato micchābhinivesato vivecetukāmo “so kho ahan”tiādinā attano dukkaracariyaṃ dassetuṃ ārabhi.
Mahāsaccake (ma. ni.1.364 ādayo) vuttanayeneva veditabbaṃ “so kho ahan”tiādipāṭhassa tattha āgataniyāmeneva āgatattā.
Pāsarāsisutte (ma. ni.1.272 ādayo) vuttanayenāti etthāpi eseva nayo.
Aṅkusaṃ gaṇhanti etena tassa gahaṇe cheko hotīti aṅkusagahaṇasippaṃ.
Meghautunti meghaṃ paṭicca uppannasītautuṃ.
Pabbatautunti pabbataṃ paṭicca uṇhautuṃ.
Ubhayavasena ca tassa tathā sītuṇhaututo eno āgatoti ta-kārassa da-kāraṃ katvā udenoti nāmaṃ akāsi.
Tāpaso ogāḷhañāṇavasena rañño matabhāvaṃ ñatvā.
Ādito paṭṭhāyāti kosambinagare parantaparañño aggamahesibhāvato paṭṭhāya.
Pubbeti sīlavantakāle.
Hatthiganthanti hatthīnaṃ attano vase vattāpanasatthaṃ.
Tenevassa taṃ sikkhāpeti, kiccañca ijjhati.
Padahanabhāvoti bhāvanānuyogo.
Padhāne vā niyutto padhāniyo, padhāniyassa bhikkhuno, tasseva padhāniyabhāvassa aṅgāni kāraṇāni padhāniyaṅgāni.
Saddhā etassa atthīti saddho.
Kiñcāpi paccekabodhisattānampi abhinīhārato paṭṭhāya āgatā āgamanasaddhā eva, mahābodhisattānaṃ pana saddhā garutarāti sā eva gahitā.
Acalabhāvena okappanaṃ “sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākhyāto dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho”ti kenaci akampiyabhāvena ratanattayaguṇe ogāhitvā kappanaṃ.
Pasāduppatti ratanattaye pasīdanameva.
Bodhinti catumaggañāṇanti vuttaṃ taṃnimittattā sabbaññutaññāṇassa, bodhīti vā sammāsambodhi.
Sabbaññutaññāṇapadaṭṭhānañhi maggañāṇaṃ, maggañāṇapadaṭṭhānañca sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ “sammāsambodhī”ti vuccati.
Nicchitasubuddhatāya dhammassa sudhammatā saṅghassa suppaṭipatti vinicchitā eva hotīti āha “desanāsīsameva cetan”tiādi.
Tassa padhānaṃ vīriyaṃ ijjhati ratanattayasaddhāya “imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇato muccissāmī”ti padhānānuyoge avaṃmukhasambhavato.
Appābādhotiādi heṭṭhā vuttameva.
Aguṇaṃ pakāsetā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjitā sammāpaṭipattiyā visodhanatthaṃ.
Udayañca atthañca gantunti “avijjāsamudayā”tiādinā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ udayañca vayañca jānituṃ.
Tenāha “etenā”tiādi.
Parisuddhāya upakkilesavinimuttāya.
Nibbijjhitunti tadaṅgavasena pajahituṃ samucchedappahānassa paccayo bhavituṃ.
Yaṃ dukkhaṃ khīyatīti kilesesu appahīnesu tena tadupanissayakammaṃ paṭicca yaṃ dukkhaṃ uppajjeyya, taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ.
Sesadivaseti sattadivasato paṭṭhāya yāva dve rattindivā.
Kucchisannissito gabbho nissayavohārena “kucchī”ti vuccati, so etissā atthīti kucchimatī.
Tenāha “āpannasattā”ti.
Ārakkho panassa paccupaṭṭhito hotīti mātarā gahitasaraṇaṃ gabbhavuṭṭhitassa tassa saraṇagamanaṃ pavedayitassa kusalaṃ saraṇaṃ nāma, mātu katarakkho puttassapi paccupaṭṭhitoti.
Mahallakakāleti vacanatthaṃ jānanakāle.
Sārentīti yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathābalaṃ ratanattayaguṇapatiṭṭhāpanavasena assa sārenti.
Sallakkhetvāti vuttamatthaṃ upadhāretvā.
Saraṇaṃ gahitaṃ nāma hoti ratanattayassa saraṇabhāvasallakkhaṇapubbakatanninnacittabhāvatova.
Sesaṃ suviññeyyameva.
